findings: Live TV drawing: com.webos.app.livetv and every hdmiN/dp/usbc/av/component/scart app are the SAME binary, /usr/bin/com.webos.app.inputcommon, run as a transparent window-group owner over the hardware video plane. Banners, popups, no-signal screensaver, Live Pick are all inputcommon QML. Preloaded at boot (bootLaunchParams.boot): processes for livetv and hdmi2 are running now. The compositor treats all of them as 'input app surfaces' (StarfishHCAPView.isInputAppSurface).

Layer stack per owner window group (z<0 = behind the transparent owner, above video): jcapLayer -2, dataLayer0-3 -5..-8 (HbbTV/Ginga/IC/MHEG), acrLayer -9 (ACR and ad overlays), dmostLayer/teletextLayer -10 (livetv only has dmost), shoppingLayer -15, ttxSubtitle -19, subtitle -20, ttmlSubtitle -21. Layer1 z=+1 holds CRB/in-front apps. inputcommon's WindowGroupInterfaces toggles them via setChildAppLayer: acr layer enabled only if com.webos.service.adoverlay answers getAppStatus AppStatus=true and no 'above view' is open.

Input apps carry no inputType, handleScreenRemoteKey, noSplashOnLaunch or enableBackgroundRun. They set transparent, lockable=false, supportQuickStart, inAppSetting, disableBackHistoryAPI, bootLaunchParams.boot; hdmi1-4 also supportTouchInputDevice and supportPortraitMode=false. Having no noSplashOnLaunch, each shows its splashBackground/bgImage (assets/HDMI-N_splash.png) on a cold launch. appinfo_nmrm.json / appinfo_oneport.json are alternate variants for other models (nmrm turns Live TV into 'LG Channels' on tunerless sets; oneport titles DisplayPort/USB-C without a number); this set uses the standard appinfo.json (listApps titles).

Physical inputs (luna eim/getAllInputStatus): maxHdmiCount 4, maxUsbcCount 0, maxDisplayportCount 0, totalCount 4. HDMI2 is connected as 'AVR-S760H' with an 'Apple TV' CEC device behind it; system.arcPort=2. dp1/2, usbc1/2, av1/2, component, scart exist in listApps but cannot be selected. Config tv.model.supportCompRcaCommon=false.

ACR / ad / tracking elements and their kill switches (values read from this TV): settings option.livePlus=off; option.broadcastInfoNoti=off (gates the Live Pick banner button); general.customizedAd=off; general.screenSaverAd=off; general.homePromotion=off; other.contentRecommendation=off; general.doNotSellMyPersonalInformation=on (acr2 and adoverlay-service both check it/limitAdTracking); general.adCookie=on; option.livePromotion=on; option.promotionStreamer=off. Other gates found in binaries: EULA flags (IsEulaAcrOnAllowed, IsEulaCustomadsAllowed, IsEulaShoppingOnAllowed, IsLimitAdTrackingOn in adoverlay-service); acr2 stores /mnt/lg/cmn_data/acr/data/{eula_allowed,eula_disallowed_rebooted,first_optout}: here only first_optout exists (ACR opt-out). Config com.webos.service.livepick.supportLivepick=true, so inputcommon still loads LivePickInterfaces, but the Live Pick card needs broadcastInfoNoti, livePlus (if needLivePlus) and two EULAs.

Mechanisms: acr2 (/usr/sbin/acr2) is a dynamic D-Bus service (starts on demand, not running now); it opens com.webos.app.acr{hdmiN,component,overlay} in the matching acrLayer. Those pages are empty shells (present_frm.html navigates to launchParams.contentTarget, input region 0, key mask none; on close they call acr/setVideoPig fullScreen and acr/closedApplication, so a Live Plus page may shrink the video). adoverlay-service (running; getAppStatus returns AppStatus=false) opens com.webos.app.adhdmiN/adoverlay (also externalinput.av/component/scart) with params.interactiveUrl; the shells just redirect to that URL. On HDMI, inputcommon ChannelInfoInterfaces sends STB channel info to ACR only when livePlus is on and the input is in STB mode (isGetCurrChInfoStbCondition); PersonalDataLogger reports acr/uei/scd watch flags. The blocked LG ad/telemetry hosts would additionally starve all of these.

admanager (/usr/sbin/admanager, running) is a different family: it launches com.webos.app.adapp ('Advertisement', web, 4.6 MB: banner + 'Exit ad' + network popup) and also names browser, tinybrowser, home, today, voice, discovery, cmp-client (consent platform), familycare; it reads adCookie, doNotSellMyPersonalInformation, eulaStatus, consentExpireDate and uses sdx for the ad server. Its l10n strings are only parental-control/app-unsupported alerts (Later/Set/'This app is no longer supported'), so admanager also fires some system alerts. With customizedAd=off and doNotSell=on, no ad content should be requested.

Dormant families on this set, with why: HbbTV (livehbbtv), Interactive Content (liveinteractivecontent), Ginga (liveginga), BML, Cuba, HybridCast, MHEG, teletext: all com.webos.service.hybridtv.support* configs = false, hybridtv-manager not running, settings hbbTV=off/hybridCast=off, ATSC US broadcast (strings: 'This function is not supported in the countries not supporting HbbTV'). CRB (BBC red button) is UK-only. Operator app (livetvopapp, HD+): hybridtv.supportOpApp=true but general.opapp mode/launchable off and operatorApp.hdplus config empty. DVR (dvrpopup, Recordings tab, record keys): tv.model.supportDvrReady=false, tv.rmm.dvrReady=false, dvr.advancedDvrReady=false, no eMMC record. Live-TV DMOST (LG Channels internet channels, livedmost): dmost daemon and the lgchannels app run and channelplus=on, so tuning an LG Channels channel inside Live TV is the only live member of this group, rare for Nitin.

Livemenu ('Guide') is a compositor overlay window opened by inputcommon CommonInputEventHandler on Key_webOS_TVGuide (activateType tvguide) and on Key_webOS_ChannelDash/LiveTVMenu/ProgramList (activateType channels); it reuses inputcommon's launch call so it is Live TV-oriented (behaviour when Guide is pressed on an HDMI input not verified [INFERENCE]). Tabs: TV Guide, Channels, Scheduler always; On Now needs supportFVP (Freeview Play, off); Recordings needs DVR (off). Pointer mouse wheel in tab state sends ChannelUp/Down to the last input; click outside closes. Also launched with activateType resume/resumeVideo/tvguide by its own error popups.

Casting: no PIN/connect dialog in the LG web apps. AirPlay is Apple's JS receiver in a native shell with its own PIN panel (client name + code), 'curtain' card (settings/HomeKit), audio now-playing and video/mirror panels; the compositor adds a floating toolbar (Move, Switch Sound, Size, Full Screen, End Connection) only to airplay and only in floating/overlay mode. Miracast shows TV name and 'Connect an LG TV from the screen sharing menu' wait screen, top menu, disconnect Yes/No; Overlay mode is off (tv.config.supportOverlayMiracast=false, tv.model.supportMirrorMode=false, settings miracastOverlayStatus/AdRecovery off). Chromecast: LG provisioning service only adds Terms-of-Service/network dialogs ('An internet connection is required to use Google Cast', 'Google Cast has been disconnected'); the cast UI itself is Google's core_runtime (not inspectable here). Triggers for all casting apps are phones.

Bluetooth: btspeakerapp (BT audio sink, shown after the 'requests Sound Share to your TV' accept/block popup from bluetooth-audio-sink) and leaudio (Auracast broadcast settings app, opaque, not transparent) are real UIs; hdmioptical ('Sound Share') is a black full-screen splash with one line of text. Popups before them come from native services (bluetooth-audio-sink, soundshare, bluetooth-le-audio) via the notification system, not these apps. Nitin's Sound Out is HDMI ARC to the Denon, which leaudio lists as 'HDMI(ARC) Device' and its strings say Auracast is 'not available in Sound Out mode' for some outputs.

Sizes for apps without a snapshot dir were measured with `du -sk` on the TV app folder (adapp 4615 KB at /mnt/otncabi, browser 12160 KB, chromecast 16 KB appinfo/icons only; the Cast runtime is separate). The twelve example apps are not in /tmp/tvsrc/apps; they were read directly on the TV (/usr/palm/applications/com.webos.exampleapp.*).
